title: Demon and Selfie
description: A blue demonic figure with large black horns and ornate headpiece emerges from a stone archway emitting white smoke, reaching toward a young woman. The woman sits on a red bed taking a selfie in an ornate mirror while tarot cards lie beside her, all under a glowing magical sigil in a cosmic sky with floating stone fragments.
prompt: A blue-skinned demon with large curved black horns and an ornate silver headpiece emerges from a stone archway, white smoke swirling around his outstretched hand. To the right, a young woman with long brown hair wearing a black tank top and patterned bandana sits on a bed with red velvet sheets, taking a selfie with her phone while looking into an ornate mirror. Tarot cards are scattered on the bed. Above them a massive glowing white magical sigil radiates light beams into a colorful cosmic sky filled with nebulae and floating stone fragments.
